meta.source: Claude Doc d497130e-096d-494b-9242-461c91da56e1 ("100 ChatGPT commands for the Hebrew image lane"), read 2026-11-03

discrepancies.note: Commands 1-10 name 31 image files (cup sample 1, sheets 2, expressions 8, variants 4, mouths 6, frames 2, backgrounds 6, consistency tests 2); command 9 is text-only. The doc says 32.
Commands 95-100 name 78 files (blessing 6, track 10, badges 8 + 8 locked, icons 40, brand 6), 79 if the optional icon grid image is counted. The doc says 76.
Net of the block discrepancies (A -1, F +2). The doc's six stated counts do add to 765; its commands yield 766.

namingNotes: Doc command 9 states the pattern L<nn>_<letter>_<print|cursive>_<mnemonic|object|scene>.png but the letter templates (commands 11-64) use suffixes _mnemonic,_ari,_noa,_silhouette,_v1-3,_s1-3 (print) and _mnemonic,_ari,_noa,_silhouette,_trace,_postcard (cursive). The templates are followed (they are the commands actually sent); the command-9 suffix list is not.
Doc command 9 vowel pattern V<nn>_<vowel>_<mnemonic|mouth>.png also differs from the vowel template suffixes (_keyword,_ari,_noa,_position,_card); the template is followed.

<letter> in file names is the contract letter id with "-" replaced by "_" (kaf_final, mem_final, nun_final, pe_final, tsadi_final; qof for Kof) so the app can map files to ids. The doc calls the finals "Khaf/Mem/Nun/Fe/Tsadi sofit".
Vowel tokens follow the doc (cholam_male and cholam_chaser are separate sets; shin_sin_dots is one set); the mapping to contract vowel ids is in tools/images/spec.mjs (VOWELS[].ids).
Lower-case file stems are used for letters/vowels/vocab themes; the doc fixes only the upper-case prefixes.
STYLE_sample_cup is a name chosen here for the unnamed command-1 sample image (the doc gives no file name).
Command 8 scenes 8-10 of each letter set say "one of the BG_ scenes" without choosing; per-image refs rotate BG_jerusalem, BG_market, BG_telaviv (assumption).
A few abstract vocabulary words were given a concrete drawable form (e.g. today -> sun and calendar day, yellow -> swatch, voice -> empty speech bubble); prompt text only, file names unaffected.
The 27 REF_cursive_<name>.png silhouettes are inputs rendered by Claude from Gveret Levin before Block C; they are listed in each cursive group's inputs and are NOT manifest rows.

ICON_* are 512x512 transparent PNGs per the doc; API image sizes are 1024-class, so tools/images/gen_via_api.mjs generates at the nearest supported size; resizing to the target dimensions is a separate human/ImageMagick step (not done here).

groups.title: Naming and manifest rules
groups.prompt: Confirm you will name every future file as: L<nn>_<letter>_<print|cursive>_<mnemonic|object|scene>.png for letters (nn = 01-27 in alphabet order, finals 23-27), V<nn>_<vowel>_<mnemonic|mouth>.png for vowels, VOC_<theme>_<nn>.png for vocabulary, PRAY_<name>.png, BADGE_<nn>.png, ICON_<name>.png. Print the full key as a table, then the manifest-line format you will append under every image.
